title: The corridor
goals: Reach the end of the path.
hints: You will need four actions in total.
Remember to put the brackets after each method.
First move right twice. Then move down twice.
intro: We need to follow this path round the corner. Give your wizard one action for every step.
outro: You reached the end of the path! You are getting good at writing instructions.
learned: Now you know that an action, which programmers call a method, needs someone to do it.
